result.title: MHR-Router: Multimodal Heterogeneous Retrieval-Enhanced Adaptive Routing for VLM Inference
result.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit complementary capabilities, yet selecting the most suitable expert for a given image-question query remains challenging due to heterogeneous multimodal inputs and varying expert strengths. Existing routing approaches rely on text-based cues or static model profiles, failing to capture fine-grained visual evidence and expert-specific failure patterns. To address this, we propose MHR-Router, a multimodal heterogeneous retrieval-enhanced adaptive routing framework for VLM inference. It accurately dispatches each multimodal query to the most suitable VLM expert via local retrieval evidence. MHR-Router consists of two stages: (1) Multimodal Routing Representation, which fuses frozen multimodal features into a comprehensive query representation; and (2) Heterogeneous Retrieval-Enhanced Adaptive Routing, which retrieves expert-specific success and failure memories as local evidence and employs a shared scorer to adaptively select the optimal expert. Experiments show that MHR-Router effectively achieves heterogeneous modality routing and consistently improves accuracy over traditional baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MHR-Router 多模态异构检索增强自适应路由框架，分两阶段：先把冻结的多模态特征融合为查询表示，再检索各专家的成功/失败记忆作为局部证据，用共享打分器为每个图像-问题选择最合适的 VLM 专家。
AI.relevance_reason: 以检索到的专家成功/失败记忆作为局部证据驱动选择的机制，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、停止/决策与贡献分配提供可核查线索，但该工作本身是专家路由，并不生成或更新 latent 推理状态。
